metas.name: 1 · ★ 8.0 · 1959 · The 400 Blows
metas.description: A young boy, left without attention, delves into a life of petty crime.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.5 · 1968 · Stolen Kisses
metas.description: After being discharged from the army, Antoine Doinel centers a screwball comedy where he applies for different jobs and tries to make sense of his relationships with women.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 7.4 · 1970 · Bed & Board
metas.description: Antoine Doinel works dying flowers in the courtyard outside his apartment. He is married to Christine, who is pregnant. He has an affair with a Japanese woman, jeopardising his marriage.
